name: Auto-Update Team Pages from Match Results

parameters.content:
## SETUP — Read Before Activating ### 1. n8n Variables (Settings → Variables) | Variable | Value | |---|---| | `FOOTBALL_DATA_API_KEY` | Key from football-data.org | | `COMPETITION_ID` | `PL` Premier League · `CL` Champions League · `PD` La Liga · `BL1` Bundesliga · `SA` Serie A · `FL1` Ligue 1 | | `CLAUDE_API_KEY` | Anthropic key from console.anthropic.com | | `WORDPRESS_URL` | e.g. `https://yoursite.com` — no trailing slash | | `WORDPRESS_AUTH_BASE64` | `base64(username:app_password)` — generate at yoursite.com/wp-admin → Users → Application Passwords | ### 2. Team Map Edit the **Team Lookup** Code node. Replace the example entries with your actual team names (exactly as returned by football-data.org) and their WordPress post IDs. See `team-config.json` in this repo. ### 3. WordPress Block Target This workflow targets `

` Gutenberg blocks. In each team page, add the CSS class `match-update` to the paragraph block you want updated (Block → Advanced → Additional CSS class). If none exists, the workflow appends a new block. ### 4. Test First Use **Test Workflow** before activating. Inspect each node's output in the execution log.
